Vendored wgpu-hal 24.0.4
Source: https://crates.io/crates/wgpu-hal/24.0.4
Upstream repository: https://github.com/gfx-rs/wgpu
Published crate commit: 993fc39b07e8a4418a15043265298d7bc016d059
License: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (full texts included)

Local modification: src/metal/device.rs recognizes the Naga function
spektrafilm_strict_float and compiles only modules containing that marker
with Metal fast math disabled and floating-point contraction disabled.
Procedural grain requires CPU binary32 intermediate rounding because its hashes
amplify a one-ULP arithmetic difference into a different noise permutation.
All other shader modules retain the upstream compilation options.

The source, examples, build script, published Cargo manifest, and VCS
provenance are copied from the published crate. Registry cache markers and
the crate's independent Cargo.lock are omitted. Full license files are
copied from the upstream commit rather than the published relative links.

Local Vulkan modification: src/vulkan/procedural_math.rs recognizes only
spektrafilm_procedural_no_contraction. Both Naga SPIR-V emission paths in
src/vulkan/device.rs add NoContraction to ordinary float add/subtract/multiply/
divide and vector-times-scalar results in this module. Explicit ExtInst Fma remains unchanged. This
marker belongs to Procedural grain (Analogue and Digital), not Spektra or MT19937. The Metal
marker remains separate. Raw SPIR-V input bypasses the Naga-specific patch.
This preserves separate rounding, not general IEEE division or denormals.
Workspace integration tests include this module to test the vendored transform.
